scope: Read-only training dashboard; model and training process unchanged

cause.description: Bounded per-file log tails merged an old retired interval with recent rows. The SVG checked adjacent array indices but not consecutive cycle numbers.

repair: The observer exposes the most recent contiguous suffix, up to its existing 128-row and 8-MiB per-file read budgets.
The line renderer starts a new segment whenever cycle numbers are not consecutive, even when array indices are adjacent.
The chart states the displayed cycle range and measured record count; raw values remain unsmoothed.

verification.visual_browser_check: Unavailable because local browser control is disabled; verified live HTTP telemetry and rebuilt client asset.
